title: Modified ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA/RNA Miniprep Kit for Parallel Extraction from Peat Soil
author: Rhiannon Mondav

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Perform initial kit setup and prepare sample tubes.

substeps.instruction: If not already done, add 96 ml 100% ethanol (or 104 ml 95% ethanol) to the 24 ml DNA/RNA Wash Buffer concentrate.
If not already done, reconstitute lyophilized DNase I with DNase/RNase-Free Water, mix by gentle inversion, and store frozen aliquots at -20°C.
For each sample, prepare and label 4 tubes with sample ID (2 'RNA', 2 'DNA').
Set up and label 5 collection tubes with sample ID (2 'DNA', 2 'RNA').
Place a yellow filter in one collection tube labeled DNA, a green column in one collection tube labeled RNA, and HRC filters in two collection tubes (one labeled DNA, one labeled RNA).

steps.title: Thaw and Transfer Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the soil samples for lysis based on their storage state.

substeps.instruction: For liquid nitrogen flash frozen samples: Transfer 0.10 g, 0.15 g, or 0.20 g of sample to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube, add 750 µl DNA/RNA Shield, cap tightly, and vortex briefly. Vortex briefly 2 or 3 more times during thaw. Measure and record sample mass.
For samples collected in DNA/RNA Shield (including those frozen at -80°C): Place on ice to thaw. Vortex briefly every five minutes (may take 30 minutes or longer).

For samples in DNA/RNA Shield: Set pipette to 50 µl more than the chosen volume, vortex or invert to mix, and transfer 750 µl, 800 µl, or 900 µl of slurry (using a pre-cut pipette tip) to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube and cap tightly.

steps.title: Bead Beating Lysis
steps.instruction: Mechanically lyse the samples using a bead beater.

substeps.instruction: Label the side of the BB Lysis Tube with the sample ID (lid labels may wear off).
Bead beat on MP Bio FastPrep for 60 seconds at 6.5 m/s, then rest for 5 minutes.
Repeat this cycle four more times for a total of 5 minutes of bead beating.

steps.title: Prepare DNase Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNase Master Mix and store on ice.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mix based on sample number: For 1 sample: 5 µl DNase I and 75 µl digestion buffer; For 6 samples: 30 µl DNase I and 450 µl buffer; For 8 samples: 40 µl DNase I and 600 µl buffer; For 12 samples: 60 µl DNase I and 900 µl buffer; For 24 samples: 120 µl DNase I and 1800 µl buffer.

steps.title: Initial DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Separate the DNA fraction using the yellow filter.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 400 µl of DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer into a labeled nuclease-free tube for each sample.
Centrifuge samples at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds.
Transfer 400 µl of the supernatant to the tube containing the lysis buffer and mix well by inversion (total volume 800 µl).
Pour or pipette the sample into a yellow Spin-Away™ Filter in a collection tube and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 45 seconds.
Transfer the yellow filter containing DNA into a new collection tube and store. SAVE the flow-through for RNA extraction.

steps.title: RNA Extraction and Purification
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the flow-through and treat with DNase.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 800 µl of 95-100% ethanol into a labeled nuclease-free tube ('RNA') for each sample.
Transfer the 800 µl flow-through from the yellow filter step to the tube with ethanol, cap tightly, and mix by inversion (total volume 1600 µl).
Transfer 700 µl of the RNA mixture into a Zymo-Spin™ IIICG Column (green) in a collection tube and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 45 seconds. Discard flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation until all RNA solution has passed through the green column.
Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the green column, centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 45 seconds, and discard flow-through.
Add 80 µl DNase I Master Mix to the green column and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Elute DNA and RNA
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and elute the nucleic acids from the filters/columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Prep Buffer to the yellow filter and green column; centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard flow-through.
Add 700 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the yellow filter and green column; centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard flow-through.

Add 400 µl DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the yellow filter and green column; centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 2 minutes at 16,000 x g for complete removal. Transfer columns to new tubes and discard old tubes/flow-through.
Add 100 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the yellow filter and green column matrix; incubate for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 30 seconds to elute DNA and RNA.

steps.title: HRC Filter Purification
steps.instruction: Further purify the eluted DNA and RNA using HRC filters.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µl ZymoBIOMICS™ HRC Prep Solution to a Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filter in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 3 minutes; discard collection tube and flow-through.
Transfer the prepared III-HRC Filter to a new tube.
Transfer the eluted DNA and RNA (from the previous step) into the prepared Zymo-Spin™ III-HRC Filters and centrifuge at exactly 16,000 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Finalize samples and prepare aliquots for testing.

substeps.instruction: Discard the filter, close the tube lid, and place on ice.
Pipette 3 to 10 µl of each sample into new tubes for purity, quantity, and quality testing.
Store actual samples in -20°C or -80°C freezers.
Optionally, make 5 µl and 10 µl aliquots for downstream testing to reduce contamination risk.
